notes.title: Wanda
notes.notes:
After quite a long break from game development, I am back with new energy.

Dear players, I would like to introduce you to Wanda, the main character of our game. 

Wanda is young, barely turned 18. He has lived all his life with his father in the countryside near the forest. 

Unfortunately, the father has fallen ill, and this event will force the young girl to travel to the forest in search of a golden fern flower. But time is short. He only has one night to do it.
